data.title: 若叶睦 · 防风林外的黄瓜切片与沉默海风
data.action: 安静地坐在松林荫蔽的长椅上，细瘦双腿并拢，双手捧着一只保鲜盒，小口嚼着自带的冰镇小黄瓜切片，浅绿长发随风垂落在肩头，淡金瞳孔平静地望向灰蓝海面
data.location: 海岸防风松林边缘的木质长椅
data.lighting: 阴天傍晚清淡柔和的冷光，无多余阴影
data.camera: side view, eye level, medium shot
data.mood: 沉默孤僻、寡言淡然、内向笨拙的真诚
data.description: 防风松林外空旷长椅上的阴天暮色。若叶睦穿着静默吉他手灰绿素色双层分体泳衣，双手捧着装着小黄瓜片的保鲜盒小口咀嚼。长长的墨绿发丝在清冷海风中飘动，她没有多余的表情与言语，只是默默地递过一片黄瓜，在沉默中传递着笨拙而真实的善意。
data.promptProse: Wakaba Mutsumi sits quietly with her legs neatly together on a weathered wooden bench bordering seaside pine woods at overcast dusk, wearing a restrained sage-green and slate-grey high-neck layered crop-top tankini and boy-cut swim shorts. Holding a small container of chilled cucumber slices in both hands as sea wind stirs her long green hair, she looks out calmly toward the grey-blue sea.
data.animaCaption: Seated neatly with knees together on a weathered wooden bench by the coastal pines in a sage-green high-neck layered tankini and grey boyshorts, she nibbles a chilled cucumber slice from a plastic box in her hands. Soft overcast dusk light and a gentle sea breeze drift across the quiet shore.
data.nsfwProse: She wears an understated sage-green and slate-grey high-neck layered crop-top tankini paired with matching boy-cut swim shorts.
